## Personality

Jane Andrews is a steady, sensible, and lady-like individual who remains calm and unflappable. Known as a plain, plodding, and conscientious student, she excels in domestic science. Although practical in her outlook, she finds teaching monotonous, despite previously intending to devote her entire life to the profession and never marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. ## History

Jane Andrews grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md). During her youth, she participated in a dramatic re-enactment of Elaine with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Ruby that ended in a mishap when their boat leaked. She later attended a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), sharing supper and reflection with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) afterwards. During her time boarding at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), she visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) and Ruby, and she ultimately graduated from the school with her peers. Before beginning her career as a teacher, Jane joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in discussing their differing philosophies on teaching and discipline. She remained close with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), joining her, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) for a picnic walk in the woods where they discovered an abandoned garden and shared their thoughts. As an active member of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), Jane accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to allow patent-medicine advertisements on his fences.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P18](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P10](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0010), +27 more_

## Quotes

> ““Of course it would be romantic,” conceded Jane Andrews, “but I know I couldn’t keep still. I’d be popping up every minute or so to see where I was and if I wasn’t drifting too far out. And you know, Anne, that would spoil the effect.”
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002)

> "The main thing will be to keep order and a teacher has to be a little cross to do that. If my pupils won’t do as I tell them I shall punish them."
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v2 IV Different Opinions P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)

> "Wouldn’t it be nice to have three wishes granted you . . . or even only one? What would you wish for, girls, if you could have a wish granted? I’d wish to be rich and beautiful and clever."
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)

> “I don’t know how you’re going to prevent him,” exclaimed Jane bitterly. “Everybody knows what Judson Parker is. He’d do anything for money. He hasn’t a spark of public spirit or any sense of the beautiful.”
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P41](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0041)

> “Oh, Anne,” gasped Jane, as they fled to the girls’ dressing room amid hearty cheers. “Oh, Anne I’m so proud! Isn’t it splendid?”
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P8](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0008)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are school friends and classmates who study together in Miss Stacy's advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. They attend social gatherings, concerts, and outdoor picnics together. Jane also joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in playful dramatic re-enactments with their group of peers.
